EGY.note: ISO 22301 is the central bank's own continuity practice, not a national IT or data standard or public-body rule.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Egypt held its annual ISO 22301 business continuity drill on 5 December 2024, operating from alternative sites and branches and remotely connected to its Disaster Recovery site; no place is named for the site.
facts.system: Central Bank of Egypt Disaster Recovery site
